scientific_integrity: Symbolic p-adic proof plus finite integer checks; no independent audit or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Determines valuations only for primes p>=5 with p!=7. The 2-adic, 3-adic and 7-adic components and full integer GCD are not claimed. Comparison with later unpublished or unindexed sources is incomplete.
title: Prime-to-42 valuations of cobalancing square-window GCDs
